purpose: Target-specific, machine-governed dispositions for container-image vulnerability findings. Replaces the bare global .trivyignore, whose entries were CVE IDs with prose governance: a bare ID suppresses that CVE EVERYWHERE, in every image and every package, so it could silently hide a genuinely new occurrence of the same CVE in a different component.
enforcement_model: The gate scans with NO suppression (--ignorefile /dev/null) to obtain the complete finding set, then reconciles that set against the records below. Trivy's own ignore mechanism is never relied upon, so suppression cannot happen without a matching governed record. A record must match EVERY consequence-relevant field of a finding — advisory id, exact configured image digest, exact resolved platform, package name, canonical PURL, installed version, severity and result target. An unmatched finding fails the gate; a record that matches nothing fails the gate as unused.
severity_policy: `severities` is an explicit governed array of the exact severities the record covers. Ambiguous composites such as HIGH_AND_CRITICAL are rejected: a record approved for HIGH must not silently absorb a CRITICAL that appears later under the same advisory id.

records.reason: Go standard-library HIGH advisories compiled into the upstream gosu 1.19 binary shipped by every current official postgres image variant. gosu executes once at container start to drop root privileges and then exits; the affected surfaces (net/http, net/mail, crypto DoS classes) are not exercised by that use. No patched official postgres build exists. The derived image changes only apk packages (libuuid, libcrypto3, libssl3, c-ares) and the config USER; /usr/local/bin/gosu is byte-identical to the base on each platform (linux/amd64 sha256 52c8749d0142edd234e9d6bd5237dff2d81e71f43537e2f4f66f75dd4b243dd0, linux/arm64 sha256 3a8ef022d82c0bc4a98bcb144e77da714c25fcfa64dccc57f6aba7ae47ff1a44; infra/images/candidates/evidence/v2/gosu-verification.txt, bound below) and its finding set is identical (22 rows, same advisories, same PURL, same target). evidence_binding: Every record cites docs/SCANNER_DISPOSITIONS.md and binds it by exact SHA-256. The gate recomputes the digest from the tracked bytes on every run, so a one-byte edit invalidates the records until re-approved. The previous references to PHASE0_EVIDENCE.md were a general gate summary that did not identify these findings, digests, platform or scanner identity, and so could not be reviewed as the basis for these decisions.

retired_records.$comment: Records that governed findings of the previously pinned official images and that match NOTHING in the derived images pinned on 2026-09-10 (the finding is fixed there). The gate rejects a record that matches nothing, so they are removed from `records`; their full text is in git history (last at b30242f) and the retirement is recorded in docs/SCANNER_DISPOSITIONS.md §3.6.
